mapper.sql: SELECT c.cand_id,c.cand_no,c.cand_nm,c.cand_se_cd,c.vndr_ptnr_id,c.job_cd,c.grd_cd, c.hope_untprc_amt,c.asgn_psbl_dt AS avail_dt, CASE WHEN c.dev_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'SIGNED' ELSE coalesce(h.cntct_stts_cd,c.cntct_stts_cd) END AS cntct_stts_cd, c.tel_no,c.cand_src_cd AS source,c.memo_desc AS rmrk_desc,c.use_yn,c.dev_id, coalesce(h.cntct_dt,c.last_cntct_dt) AS last_cntct_dt,c.created_at FROM hr.cand c LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.cntct_stts_cd,x.cntct_dt FROM hr.cand_cntct_hist x WHERE x.cand_id=c.cand_id ORDER BY x.cntct_dt DESC,x.created_at DESC,x.cntct_hist_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) h ON true
mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM () r ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) AS candidate_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.cntct_stts_cd='INTV') AS interview_count, count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.avail_dt <= #{nextMonthEnd}) AS available_by_next_month_count, count(*) FILTER(WHERE coalesce(r.last_cntct_dt,r.created_at::date) < #{cutoff}) AS uncontacted_over_30_days_count FROM () r
SELECT cand_id FROM hr.cand WHERE cand_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y' FOR UPDATE
SELECT skl_cd FROM hr.cand_skl WHERE cand_id=#{id} ORDER BY skl_cd
SELECT cntct_dt,cntct_stts_cd,memo_desc AS memo,rcrd_user_id AS user_id,created_at FROM hr.cand_cntct_hist WHERE cand_id=#{id} ORDER BY cntct_dt DESC,created_at DESC,cntct_hist_id DESC

SELECT n.need_id,o.oppt_id,o.oppt_nm,n.job_cd,n.bgn_ym,n.expc_untprc_amt AS monthly_price, (SELECT s.num_val::bigint FROM cmn.oprt_std s WHERE s.oprt_std_id='TEAM_FEE' AND s.aply_bgn_ym <= n.bgn_ym ORDER BY s.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) AS team_expense FROM hr.cand c JOIN bsn.oppt_need n ON n.job_cd=c.job_cd AND n.use_yn='Y' JOIN bsn.oppt o ON o.oppt_id=n.oppt_id AND o.oppt_stts_cd='OPEN' WHERE c.cand_id=#{id} AND c.use_yn='Y' AND c.asgn_psbl_dt <= (to_date(n.bgn_ym||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD')+interval '1 month - 1 day')::date ORDER BY n.bgn_ym,n.need_id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cmn.cd_dtl d JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=d.cd_grp_id WHERE d.cd_grp_id=#{group} AND d.dtl_cd=#{code} AND d.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.ptnr WHERE ptnr_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y' AND ptnr_se_cd IN ('VEND','BOTH'))
